steps.note: Natural cheeses of different types and ages are shredded and blended.

steps.what: emulsifying salts, water, salt and milk fat
steps.note: The emulsifying salts, which bind calcium so the casein can hold the fat, are usually used at no more than 3-4 %.
The blend is heated with constant stirring until it is homogeneous; one source gives 80-85 °C for 4-8 min.
It is packaged hot, then cooled and stored at 5-10 °C.
